headline: Approved $462,755.00 loan for additional design of Fire Administration Wing at Police Station.
summary: Officials presented changes to the design of the Police Station project. The new concept relocates fire administration, and total additional costs are $901,226.00, with drug forfeiture funds covering the cost above the loan amount. The project will take a few more months, depending on when DPW moves off the site.

decision_titles: $462,755.00 loan for additional design of Fire Administration Wing
plain_text:
Long Term Debt Committee 
October 19, 2026 
Minutes of the Meeting 
 
Attendance 
Councillor Durkee   Present 
Councillor Hanley   Present 
Councillor King   Present 
Councillor LaCava   Absent 
Councillor Bradley-MacArthur Present 
 
Chairman Durkee called the meeting to order at 6:00 pm.  
 
Councillor Bradley-MacArthur moved approval of October 5, 2026, minutes.  Motion 
was adopted on a voice vote. 
 
Councillor King moved to hear from all off-committee members.  Motion was adopted on 
a voice vote. 
 
1. The Mayor respectfully requests approval of a loan authorization in the amount of 
$462,755.00 for the additional design services for the inclusion of the Fire 
Administration Wing of the Police Station. 
 
Purchasing Agent Crystal Philpott and Police Chief Kevin O’Connell appeared before 
the committee. Ms. Philpott gave a brief presentation regarding the most recent 
changes to the ongoing design phase of this project.  This new concept that came up 
at the last meeting will relocate fire administration. This change will eliminate the 
need to add additional space to the building.  Total additional costs are $901,226.00.  
Drug forfeiture funds will be used to cover the remaining cost that exceeds the loan 
order amount. Councillor Bradley-MacArthur asked how this new design is different 
than the previous design plans.  Councillor Hanley asked how this affects the 
previous timeline. Ms. Philpott said it will add a few months to the project.  Ms. 
Philpott said the timing really hinges on when DPW moves off the site.   
Councillor Hanley made a motion for approval. Motion was approved on a voice 
vote. 
 
Councillor Hanley moved to adjourn.  Motion was adopted and the meeting was 
adjourned at 6:07 pm. 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Thamas J. Magno - Clerk
